newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Fu Yu sees no significant improvement.
newsitem.headline: Fu Yu sees no significant improvement.

text.p: Fu Yu Manufacturing Ltd said on Thursday that it does not expect any significant improvements in its second half performance over the first half.

"In view of the continuing weakness in the electronics industry and barring any unforeseen circumstances, the directors do not anticipate any significant improvements in the second half year's performance over the first half," said the company in a note accompanying its first half results.
Fu Yu announced a 4.9 percent rise in first half net profit to Singapore $6.47 million.
It said the slowdown in the electonics industry has affected supporting industries and the group experienced keener competition and lower margins during the period under review.
